cards.quote: “The format was excellent! Good mixture of solution providers and subject matter experts. The Location was exceptional, and the networking experience was awesome. Great job!”
Thank you all for everything you did to make this event another incredible experience. This is by far one of the best managed, architected, and thoughtful/engaging conferences that is out there.
“It was such an incredible event! I feel like my pen was on fire taking notes and writing down insights. The content was helpful and relevant. I hope to attend the next one!”

"Very polished and supportive staff, as well as gorgeous, luxurious venue, helps this conference stand out among the many I have spoken at over the past 6 years. Also, atmosphere was very positive, friendly, and low-pressure."
"I feel very proud to be part of this conference series. Its an amazing and well-run event with incredible quality talent. This was my favourite stream/session so far"
“Loved the intentionality of these meetings and the opportunity to have designated times to sit down with the vendors.”
"Loved the conference. It was the right amount of balance between sessions, business meetings and social/networking!"

“It was great having the opportunity to speak with the service providers one on one. The idea of big conferences and a 'tradeshows' to speak with vendors is outdated and not useful. This size, this approach and this format was GREAT!”
“Great event. I learned at every turn, and the panelists and participant representation was top shelf!”
"Absolute 5 stars all around!"
"The size of the event allowed for meaningful opportunities to connect with people - both peers and outside counsel."
“Very well put together and the IPMI staff were extremely professional and helpful.”
"5-Star experience from top to bottom. Event organizing, venue, networking had it all."

“Really enjoyed the event! This was my first time attending an IPMI program and I am already looking forward to the next opportunity. Beautiful venue, amazing service, and really enjoyed the one on one discussions.”
"IPMI knocked it out of the park. I would attend year after year, and hope I am invited back!"
"Loved the panels! It was great to hear other leaders discuss hot topics, projects, and issues. "
“One of the best sales conferences that I have ever been to. Productive and impactful.”
"I LOVE this event. I learn so much from problem solving with my peers."

“I’ve been to two events now, and must say by far it is one of my best professional learning experiences in my career. The intimate group, unlike SHRM, and the professional level of information is just right.”
"Just WOW. It really was an incredible experience for me. As a first-time attendee, I wasn't sure what to expect; it exceeded my expectations."

“Truly an outstanding event, well assembled, attended, perfect venue, size, which offered ample time for collaboration, exchange of ideas and formation of new partnerships, while refreshing old friendships.”

“Just WOW. It really was an incredible experience for me. As a first-time attendee, I wasn’t sure what to expect; it exceeded my expectations. I got so much out of this event. Wonderful conference and would love to come back.”
